fields.title: Hello, World!
fields.content:
Welcome to gLifestream, your own self-hosted lifestream. This first entry is a selfpost: something written here rather than imported from elsewhere.

A few things to try:

  • Sign in as admin / admin and choose a new password.
  • Add your services under Settings → Services: RSS and Atom feeds, Mastodon, Bluesky, PixelFed, Flickr, YouTube, Vimeo. You can also import an OPML file. The background worker brings their entries into this stream.
  • Write your own posts with Add content at the top of the stream: text, links, photos and videos.
  • Organize: group services into lists, mark favorite entries, keep a service private or a post visible only to friends.
  • Share the stream as a web page, an Atom feed or JSON. WebSub sends new entries to subscribers.

Paste a YouTube or Vimeo link into a post and it becomes a player, like Caminandes 3: Llamigos from the Blender Studio below. Click it to play.

Edit this entry to make it your own, or hide it once you no longer need it.
